description:
Run and debug a Java program in Eclipse IDE. The project files are at ~/eclipse-workspace/gs-maven/.

Your task:
1. Import the Maven project from ~/eclipse-workspace/gs-maven/ into Eclipse
2. Open HelloWorld.java in the editor (located in src/main/java/hello/)
3. Build the project (Project > Build Project or Maven build)
4. Run the HelloWorld main class (Run As > Java Application) to see normal output
5. Set a breakpoint on the line containing 'System.out.println(greeter.sayHello())' - click in the left margin (gutter) to add a breakpoint marker
6. Debug the program (Debug As > Java Application)
7. When the debugger stops at the breakpoint, inspect the 'greeter' variable in the Variables view
8. Step over (F6) to execute the print statement
9. Resume execution (F8) and let the program complete
